gloss: main part; main story; this volume

definitions.gloss: main part; main story; main feature
definitions.explanation: The primary or main portion of a work, as opposed to supplementary material such as spin-offs, sequels, bonus content, or behind-the-scenes footage.
A reference to the current book, document, or work being discussed.

examples.japanese: {本編|ほんぺん}は{来月|らいげつ}{公開|こうかい}される。
examples.english: The main feature will be released next month.

examples.japanese: この{映画|えいが}の{本編|ほんぺん}は{二時間|にじかん}ある。
examples.english: The main feature of this movie is two hours long.

examples.japanese: スピンオフが{人気|にんき}だが、やはり{本編|ほんぺん}のストーリーが{一番|いちばん}{面白|おもしろ}い。
examples.english: The spin-off is popular, but the main story is still the most interesting.

examples.japanese: {詳|くわ}しくは{本編|ほんぺん}{第三章|だいさんしょう}を{参照|さんしょう}してください。
examples.english: Please refer to Chapter 3 of this volume for details.

examples.japanese: {本編|ほんぺん}の{内容|ないよう}は{前作|ぜんさく}の{知識|ちしき}がなくても{楽|たの}しめる。
examples.english: You can enjoy this volume even without knowledge of the previous work.

examples.japanese: {本編|ほんぺん}では{基礎的|きそてき}な{理論|りろん}を{解説|かいせつ}し、{応用例|おうようれい}は{別冊|べっさつ}に{譲|ゆず}る。
examples.english: This volume covers basic theory, and application examples are left to a separate volume.

notes:
A compound of {本|ほん} (main; this) and {編|ぺん} (compilation; volume). Very commonly used in entertainment media — anime, manga, movies, video games — to distinguish the main story from side stories, OVAs, bonus episodes, or behind-the-scenes content.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本編|ほんぺん}に{戻|もど}る: to return to the main story
- {本編|ほんぺん}の{内容|ないよう}: the content of the main part
- {本編|ほんぺん}{映像|えいぞう}: main feature footage
- {本編|ほんぺん}とは{別|べつ}に: separately from the main story

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {番外編|ばんがいへん}: side story; extra episode — content outside the main narrative
- {外伝|がいでん}: side story; spin-off — a separate story featuring secondary characters or events
- {続編|ぞくへん}: sequel; continuation — the next installment following the main story
- {前編|ぜんぺん}: first part — the first half of a work divided into parts
